description: Runs on a private regtest node (Qbit Core v1.0.1), recorded as they happened. The same runs were first made on Qbit Core v1.0.0: every accept or reject result, every reject reason and every transaction size was the same. `reveal_runs` are reveal transactions (PINS-1 §11, PINS-2, Q7, Q13): `accepted` is the node policy result (testmempoolaccept or sendrawtransaction), and `p2mr_inscriptions` is what the reference indexer reported for the block that mined the transaction. Rejected runs have no block. The offline test in `packages/indexer/regtest-runs.test.ts` parses every `raw_hex`, runs the reference rules engine on it, and compares the result with `p2mr_inscriptions`. A run whose reveal leaf version is reserved was mined with generateblock, which skips policy; consensus accepted it and the indexer reported no P2MR Inscription.

reorg.description: A reorganisation of depth 2 on regtest. Branch A mined X in H+1 (number 18), Y in H+2 (number 19) and an empty block H+3. The last two blocks were invalidated and branch B mined W in H+2, V in H+3 and an empty block H+4. X stayed in the common block H+1. The indexer followed both branches: number 19 passed from Y to W, W and V were numbered 19 and 20, and the final state hash equals the one of a fresh indexer that followed the final chain from the first block.

trade.description: A P2MR Inscription listed with a PSBT signed SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY (0x83) by the seller, completed by a buyer with the clean template (PINS-6 §4.2), broadcast and mined. `trade_tx_hex` is the completed transaction. The indexer put the P2MR Inscription at `new_location`, owned by the buyer.

listing_invalidated.description: A listing of a P2MR Inscription is signed by the seller with SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY (0x83). testmempoolaccept allows the completed transaction while the P2MR Inscription output is unspent. The seller then spends that output and the spend is accepted to the mempool; testmempoolaccept still reports the completed listing as allowed while the spend is unconfirmed. After the spend is mined the completed listing is rejected with missing-inputs, and the indexer shows the P2MR Inscription at the seller's spend. A buyer must therefore treat a listing as valid only until the P2MR Inscription output is spent, and re-check the output right before signing (PINS-6 §8).
